question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"betrays."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Betrays"** means to reveal or be disloyal to someone's trust or confidence. (शत्रु को गोपनीय मामलों की जानकारी देना; रहस्‍य उजागर करना) • **Example**: She* **betrays**__ all the members of the group to the secret police.* • *​*This fits the context of the blank. • The correct answer is Option 3. • **Correct paragraph**: English Ivy __**betrays**__ its poor reputation as a nuisance by its unparalleled ability to provide shade. By seamlessly covering the exterior of a building, it works as a natural ______ (2) ______, blocking the sun and decreasing air conditioning costs. This means big savings for both building tenants and homeowners ______ (3) ______. And it can happen quickly, too. Under the proper conditions, established English Ivy can grow to cover ______ (4) ______ of roughly 500 square feet per year. Given that most homes have a roof measuring roughly 2000 square feet, ivy-friendly homeowners can rest assured that their roofs will be ______ (5) ______ covered in about four years.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "Portrays" means to depict or represent something or someone in a particular way. It is not suitable in the given context. (किसी को चित्र में दर्शाना; किसी का लेख में वर्णन या चित्रण करना) • "Follows" means to come after or go behind someone or something. It is not appropriate in the given context. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के पीछे आना, जाना या होना) • "Punishes" means to impose a penalty or consequence on someone for their actions. It is not relevant in the given context. ((ग़लती या बुरे काम के लिए) किसी को दंड देना) 1eb:Teff, The correct answer is **"insulator."**
